name: display-dev
description: Publish, find, edit, and share HTML or Markdown documents with access controls.

interface.longDescription:
display.dev (Display) gives your agent a place to publish and keep its work: reports, specs, dashboards, prototypes and decks, as HTML or Markdown. Each document is a page at its own URL. Your team opens it with the Google or Microsoft account they already use, or with a one-time password.

Documents live in Spaces: My Space for your own work, and Shared Spaces for your team. You choose who can open each file or folder: only you, people you invite, your organization, or anyone with the link.

Your team comments directly on the page. The agent reads the comments, edits the source and saves the next version at the same URL. The document keeps its comments alongside its version history.

With this plugin, your agent can:
- publish a new document, or a new version of an existing one
- find, search and read your files and their source
- make exact edits, and rename, copy, move or delete files and folders
- share a file or folder with a teammate or client, and change who can open it
- read, add, resolve and reopen comments

Owners and Admins can also manage members, Shared Spaces, and the organization logo. Only Owners can manage verified email domains and assign group administrators. Owners and assigned group administrators can update groups and their membership.

You sign in to display.dev through OAuth. Each call uses your account, your organization and the access you already have. The agent cannot open anything you cannot open.
